author: Jiawei Zhang
task_instruction: Run through my portfolio from an income perspective - check each holding's current price and browse any relevant news. Email an income analysis summarizing the portfolio's yield characteristics to henry.nakamura@tokyocapital.com. Include each holding's trailing EPS, the P/E ratio, and note which stocks pay dividends (with the yield percentage) versus which do not.
